Goal GOAL_ROUTING_RELIABILITY (Preserve request progress across route failures)
Feature FEAT_RATE_LIMIT_ROUTING (Rate-limit-aware routing)
Requirement REQ_RATE_LIMIT_ROUTING (Rate-limit-aware route and key selection): Blocked routes shall be skipped when another route is available. When all routes are blocked, the router shall fail immediately or wait according to configured policy. Available credentials shall rotate before reuse requires waiting.
Technical requirement TREQ_RATE_LIMIT_STATE (Isolated limiter state): Rate-limit state shall remain isolated per provider and key, apply the more conservative configured request interval, record every failed attempt in the transient failure state of its provider and key, and reset that state after success.
Its verification criteria: State in one provider/key bucket does not block another key of that provider or the same key ID under another provider.; The limiter uses the longer spacing interval in both RPS-dominant and RPM-dominant configurations.; A failed attempt counts in the transient failure state of its own provider and key: at the threshold that key alone is blocked.; A success clears transient failure count so a later failure sequence must reach the configured threshold again.

        current = monotonic() if now is None else now
        should_log_opened = False
        with self._lock:
